name: The Venture Co.
label: Quest
description: Investigating a ravaged Venture Company caravan in Mulgore uncovers an aggressive buildup of Venture Company goblins digging into the eastern hills.…
intro: Investigating a ravaged Venture Company caravan in Mulgore uncovers an aggressive buildup of Venture Company goblins digging into the eastern hills. Having had their formal requests for mining permits flatly rejected, the company chose to quarry the Earth Mother's soil anyway, prompting Morin Cloudstalker to commission a lethal response.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. Employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... Their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Venture Co. Was refused mining rights here in Mulgore, but it would seem that they do not take no for an answer. We tauren are not ones to mince words, however, and we have other ways of getting our message across.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. Will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
